title: Banqueting House
visualBrief: Whole surviving Banqueting House, Whitehall: full8point native building contour including set-back north James Wyatt stair annex; two principal storeys over rusticated basement, seven bays on both long faces, shallow advanced middle3bays, Ionic lower order/Composite upper order, alternating lower window pediments, upper cornice hoods, garland frieze and balustraded parapet, concealed low roof and intrinsic1688weathervane. Northern annex entrance/roundel/bands. Exclude separate RUSI, Ministry of Defence, Horse Guards, old southern low gateway in historical images, lost Whitehall Palace, general street/grounds/interiors/temporary flags and people. Pale grey-white Portland stone; genuine recessed sash windows/reveals/grids, projected orders/entablatures/alternating segmental and triangular lower pediments, center3bay emphasis, corner double pilasters, open balustrade and wrought-iron vane. Whole slight-tapered mainhall plus inset northannex. Fine decorative masks/garlands and exact levels/hidden detail estimates; do not impose old gate or lost palace.
